 Kathmandu’s Rashid Khan Scores Half-Century Against Karnali Yaks in NPL
 Ratopati
 November 02, 2026
 Read in Nepali
 Kathmandu. Kathmandu Gurkhas' Rashid Khan has been dismissed after scoring a half-century against Karnali Yaks in the Nepal Premier League (NPL).
 Rashid was dismissed after scoring 50 runs off 32 balls. He hit 3 fours and 2 sixes. Karnali has taken their fifth success by dismissing him. With 16.4 overs played, Kathmandu has lost 5 wickets for 145 runs.
